title: Nell Finds a Snug Gap
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4, 67-sound stage (sl, sm, sn, sp just added).

pages.illustration: Nell the bee resting on a wooden bird table perch.
Wind beginning to stir the leaves and sway the bird table.

pages.text: Nell can not flap up in this.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee struggling against strong gusts of wind.

pages.text: Nell spots a gap in the wood.
pages.illustration: Nell spotting a small gap in the wooden post of the bird table.
Nell the bee squeezing into the small gap in the post.

pages.text: Nell is snug in the gap.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee sitting snugly inside the gap, sheltered from the wind.
Branches and leaves whipping about outside in the strong wind.
The wind calming, leaves settling still again.
Nell the bee flying back up onto the bird table perch.
